title: Own Your Generated Code
hook: Signhify code is 100% MIT licensed. You own the output.

scenes.narration: Signhify generates sites under an MIT license, giving you full ownership of every line.
scenes.headline: You own the code

scenes.narration: You receive a ZIP containing the full front‑end and a starter Express API, all under MIT, ready to host anywhere.
scenes.headline: No vendor lock, you keep the code

scenes.narration: Iterative chat editing lets you refine the prompt, then you export a ready‑to‑run ZIP, keeping the source under MIT.
scenes.headline: Export, edit, and deploy yourself

scenes.narration: Each site compiles over 400 frames from an eight‑second video, delivering rich parallax without WebGL.
scenes.headline: 400+ frames per site
